title: Career Break & Reentry Cost Engine
subtitle: Break Feasibility Engine + Reentry Cost Modeler
data_vintage: Tab 1: Zero maintenance (user-entered inputs only). Tab 2: Industry reentry penalty curves — SHRM 2024 · BLS OEWS May 2023 · CFA Institute 2024 · NALP 2024 · IEEE 2024 · AGC 2024. Annual spot-check recommended.
regulatory_citations: IEEE 2024 Salary & Benefits Survey (engineering reentry data)
downstream_handoff_note: Tab 1 → AL-03 (Human Capital Engine) for skills depreciation analysis. Tab 2 → AL-08+14 (Career Transition Suite) for career pivot planning.

mcp_tool_definition.name: model_career_break_cost
mcp_tool_definition.description: Model the full financial cost of a career break (lost income, 401k compounding gap, Social Security impact, break timing NPV) and the industry-specific reentry salary penalty by break duration and role level. Returns two AP2-compliant mandates under career_break_record: break_feasibility (Tab 1) and reentry_cost (Tab 2). Accepts AP2 inbound from severance_decision_record (AL-24), career_pivot_assessment, and career_transition_record (AL-08+14).

break_duration_months.description: Planned career break duration in months.

monthly_expenses_usd.description: Monthly essential expenses during the break (housing, food, utilities), USD.

liquid_savings_usd.description: Current liquid savings / assets available for the break, USD.

cobra_monthly_usd.description: Monthly COBRA or ACA premium estimate during break. 2025 avg: ~$584 individual / ~$1,850 family.

k401_contrib_rate_pct.description: Annual 401(k) contribution rate as % of salary (include employer match).

industry.description: Industry for Tab 2 reentry penalty modeling.

role_level.description: Planned reentry role level: same (same title/level), step_down (one level below), lateral (new field).
